title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES LARGE CORPORATIONS TO PROVIDE FOR RICE REQUIREMENTS OF THEIR EMPLOYEES

text.en:
For a period to be recommended by the Department of
Agriculture (DA), but in no case less than two years from the effectivity of this
Executive Order, large corporations shall be encouraged to provide the rice
requirements of their respective employees either by engaging in the production
of rice as hereafter provided, or by importing rice to meet the requirements.

For purposes of this Executive Order, large corporations
shall pertain to corporations duly organized and existing under Philippine laws
that. have five hundred (500) employees or more, provided that, said
corporations have reported profit in the last four years before this Executive
Order, and they can engage in the production or importation of the rice
PGMA Hologram • 46371

requirements of their employees without substantially affecting their financial
The National Food Authority (NFA) is hereby ordered to generate a list of
the large corporations, as defined herein.

Large corporations with existing landholdings determined to
be suitable for rice production by the DA that decide to engage in said
production shall be encouraged to do so, within a period to be determined by the
Large corporations without landholdings for rice production that decide to
engage in rice production, pursuant to this Executive Order, may engage in rice
production and may lease public agricultural lands or idle agricultural lands,
subject to the agreement of the landowner thereof.
Large corporations that decide to import rice shall signify their intention to
do so with the NFA and shall be governed in such importation by law.
For purposes of this Section, large corporations may register with the NFA
at any time during the effectivity of this Executive Order.

Rice importations pursuant to this Executive Order shall be
coursed through the NFA and shall be eligible for fiscal privileges, within the
authority of the NFA to provide. However, the NFA may charge reasonable fees
for services rendered for such importation.

Any rice production, pursuant to this Executive Order, which
is in excess of the consumption requirements of the employees of a subiect large
corporation, may be sold in the local markets.

The DA, upon consultation with the Department of Agrarian
Reform, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources, the Board of
Investments, and the Department of Finance, shall develop a package of fiscal or
non-fiscal incentives, as may be allowed by law, for the effective implementation
of this Executive Order.

Large corporations may enter into any agreement or form
associations for the purpose of engaging in rice production pursuant to this
Executive Order.

The DA shall formulate and issue Implementing Rules and
Regulations (IRR) of this Executive Order in consultation with concerned
government agencies and the private sector.
PGMA Holoram & 46372

Moral suasion and not compulsion shall be applied to the
large corporations in carrying out the purposes of this Executive Order.

Executive Order No. 721 is hereby amended and
superseded by this Executive Order.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately after
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila this 3rd day of November
, in the year of our
Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
By the President:
Other h. livey
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
